## Stop condition
All pre-registered configurations have been run once. No test, feature follow-up, model expansion, transfer, source selection, SSL/DG, CALCE or additional grid is authorized by this result.

## Pre-registered interpretation

`PARTIAL_RECOVERY` is the only permitted conclusion. The same F0 Ridge family
improved both historical controls without catastrophic outputs: B0007 RMSE fell
from 5.988 to 3.341 (44.2% lower) but remained R² = -1.219; B0018 improved from
1.564 to 1.189 (24.0% lower) with R² = 0.569. Thus B0007 fails the required
positive-R² condition, so this is not `STRONG_BASELINE_RECOVERED` and not a
successful estimator.

F1 did not provide cross-target recovery: relative to F0 Ridge, its RMSE worsened
from 3.341 to 3.556 on B0007 and from 1.189 to 1.755 on B0018. The best B0007
mean RMSE was small MLP F0 (2.715), but its five-seed RMSE standard deviation was
1.049 and mean R² remained -0.640; its B0018 counterpart was worse than F0 Ridge.
No configuration produced catastrophic predictions, but none gave positive R² on
both targets.

The strongest supported failure attribution is `NONSTATIONARY_MAPPING`, with
`TEMPORAL_CONTEXT_INSUFFICIENT` as a secondary diagnosis for the frozen F1
features. This is based on the observed train/validation HF–SOH association shifts,
the F0/F1 comparison, and persistent negative B0007 R². It does not establish a
physical causal mechanism and does not authorize further feature search.
